title: Three core applications. One ecosystem.
intro: Rewards and Notifications connect the applications, while AI Agents provide intelligence across them.

pos.subtitle: The multi-company business foundation of GMO
pos.multiNote: One POS platform. N companies. Tenant-isolated data.
agents: Support agents that solve problems immediately
Agent that helps register all your inventory
Agent that tells you when to buy more inventory
Agent that pays your services and bills

loans.subtitle: Loans between people: people who need money borrow directly from people who want to lend it — SmartLoans is not a bank
loans.callout: AI does not determine credit limits. AI assists the workflow. Money movement stays approval-controlled.

arcade.subtitle: Gaming & entertainment platform
arcade.text: Arcade / Casino is a dedicated GMO application for gaming and entertainment. It operates alongside POS GMO and Rewards while maintaining its own application workflows and business rules.
arcade.creditsText: Arcade / Casino credits are a separate concept. They are not POS money and not Rewards points.
arcade.callout: Games become another customer engagement channel, while Rewards connects that engagement back to the wider GMO ecosystem.
